link_footprint.provenance: ROM probe by button inputs only from EmulatorCache.interactive (Link at (70,52), place [163,16]): after N frames of up, 70 frames of left. Free to x=20 for y 38..28, blocked at x=68 for y 39..52, so the free row-1 band is y 26..38 (center 32, offsets -6..+6; 26 is also the top limit of the room, so the lower edge 38/39 is the measured one). Right walk at y=26 stops at x=108. Width 8 is inferred from the left stop x=20 against the 16 px wall cell, not measured separately; the row band is generalised from row 1 to other rows by the 16 px cell, not measured.

gap_entry.provenance: ROM probe 2026-11-05 on a restored copy of keyframe 32400 of run 20261104-153743-acc2 (room 165/16, Link at y 64 on row 3 above the one-cell stairs at (4,3), tiles 78 78 78 78, between ledge cells of tiles 29 29 39 39): holding down from x 53..60 entered the stairs (the game slides Link to x 56 or 57, then 0.5 px per frame on the stairs), from x 52 (offset -4) Link did not move in 90 frames. Offsets are x minus the cell centre (col * 16 + 8).

talk_reach.provenance: talk reach probe 2026-11-02 on restored copies: Link poked to the person's position plus 8..24 px along one axis and aligned on the other, the facing byte set without a step, A for 3 frames, a dialogue within 40 frames; run 20261102-075426-e333 frame 7990 (type 115 at (40,96), room 179/0) and frame 6420 (types 62 at (88,64) and 63 at (120,80), room 163/16): the farthest distance that opened a dialogue was 19 px facing up, 20 down, 15 left and 16 right for all three, and every distance from 14 up to it opened one. Distance is the person's x or y minus Link's, in the RAM coordinates of link_x/link_y and entity_x/entity_y.

shield_range.provenance: hypothesis (owner decision 2026-11-09): hold the shield while walking when an enemy is within its contact_px plus 3 cells; the distance is chosen, not measured. The shield hold itself costs no speed and no turn (owner measurement); that it blocks a type 9 hit from the front while walking is the probe in data/entities.json.

sword_reach.provenance: sword census 2026-11-12 (bin/koholint census sword, restored copies of sword-holding states: run 20261111-194737-9ba1 frames 60404 (242/0), 61350 (226/0), 62000 and 62400 (243/0); attack demo runs 20261111-235344-d069 frame 60584 (241/0) and 20261111-235114-d8f2 frame 60688 (243/0), both forked from checkpoint sword-obtained): Link placed at 8 to 40 px from each enemy along each facing (2 frames of the direction, then A for 3 frames, a hit is entity_health lower or the slot status leaving 5 within 20 frames) and sideways at 16 px; every slot of types 9, 197 and 198 (12 slots) was hit at 14 to 22 px in every facing measured and with a sideways offset of -8..+8 px (the farthest hits were 24 to 36 px, the sideways band -10..+16 px); a hit lands 3 frames after A up to 26 px and 6 frames after A beyond; the struck enemy flashes for 24 frames (0xC420, hypothesis). Spin: holding A for 56 frames or more (54 did not) then releasing hit an enemy 16 px behind Link in 13 of the 14 slots (types 9, 14, 197, 198), a 3-frame tap from behind never did; the attack skill does not use it. along and cross are the strike window of skills/attack.rb; the closest distance is the type contact_px plus 2.
